rules.logic: XQL(ASM-003 Xpanse Subdomain / Certificate / Identity Discovery Delta) AND (BIOC(ASM EAL — Outbound Subdomain-Enumeration DNS Burst) OR BIOC(ASM EAL — Outbound OSINT Aggregator Egress With Tooling User-Agent)) — raises a single exposure-management reconnaissance incident when the OSINT harvesting egress co-occurs with Cortex ASM/Xpanse independently enumerating the same external footprint.
rules.name: Exposure Management — Organisation Under Open-Source Reconnaissance
